name: decision-pack
title: Duplicate decision pack
for_each: select id,code from duplicate_groups order by code

sections.title: Review assignment
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due_on,status from duplicate_groups where id=$1

sections.title: Source fields
sections.sql: select m.external_id,r.name,r.fields,r.version,r.protected from members m left join records r on m.external_id=r.external_id where m.group_id=$1 order by m.external_id

sections.title: Decision history
sections.sql: select master_id,values,provenance,versions,reason,actor,state,created_at from proposals where group_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Reviewer notes
sections.sql: select body,actor,created_at from notes where group_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Business
sections.sql: select name from workspace where id=$1

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select c.* from v_compliance c where exists(select 1 from workspace where id=$1) order by rule,record

sections.title: Evidence of changes
sections.sql: select action,actor,detail,created_at from history where exists(select 1 from workspace where id=$1) order by created_at
